envelope.description: The document lookups and the module profile read items from their file

body.title: The document lookups and the module profile read items from their file
body.summary: Replace the SECTION_BODY_CHARS slices of doc-constraint-enumerate and doc-decision-trace and the ENTRYPOINT_SCAN_CHARS slices of module-profile (two sites) with reads through measure(entity), so the whole item is used when the file still holds it and an unconfirmable item is reported as not covered.
acceptanceChecks: A section longer than the former 2,000-character cut is read whole by both document lookups
A module profile recognises an entry point beyond the former first 4,096 characters, and an unconfirmable file is reported as not covered

tests.name: partly-read.test.ts: doc.constraint.enumerate and doc.decision.trace read a section longer than the former cut whole and report an unconfirmable section as not covered
module-profile-entrypoint.test.ts: an entry point beyond the former first 4,096 characters is recognised and an unconfirmable file is reported as not covered
